Question: A man walked a certain distance at a constant rate. If he had gone \(\frac12\) mile per hour faster, he would have walked the distance in four-fifths of the time; if he had gone \(\frac12\) mile per hour slower, he would have been \(2\frac12\) hours longer on the road. The distance in miles he walked was:
